model: Sensedge SE-100 smart air quality monitor (BACnet IP)
equipment_type: Indoor air quality sensor (PM, TVOC, CO2, temperature, humidity)
applies_to: Kaiterra Sensedge (full size, model SE-100) indoor air quality monitors with BACnet IP enabled, firmware 1.15.12.
summary: The Sensedge monitor serves its readings on BACnet IP (IPv4 and IPv6, UDP 47808) as nine Analog Inputs: PM2.5, PM10, TVOC, temperature, humidity, CO2, an unassigned slot and two sensor-module lifespans. All objects support COV.
notes: The PICS has no access column; all objects are listed as read-only readings (only Units and COV_Increment are writable).
Units are not given in the PICS; the Units property is writable.
AI 7 and AI 8 are both printed as 'KM10X Module Lifespan'.
The PICS marks Analog Inputs as dynamically creatable/deletable; the list printed is the default set.
BACnet support depends on the Sensedge version and firmware.
Source: Kaiterra Sensedge BACnet PICS, February 2024.

source.title: Kaiterra Sensedge BACnet Protocol Implementation Conformance Statement (PICS)

integration.summary: Enable BACnet IP on the monitor, give it a unique device instance, then read CO2, PM2.5, TVOC, temperature and humidity. COV subscriptions are supported.
setup: BACnet IP on Ethernet or Wi-Fi, IPv4 and IPv6, UDP port 47808.
Device instance, name, description and location are writable.
gotchas: Two objects share the name 'KM10X Module Lifespan'; map by instance.
Check the Units property; the PICS does not state default units.
